column1: # Reachable dimensions (D427 (2)): the quests that show the player can reach a dimension beyond
# the Overworld and the Nether (always reachable). Read by gregtec.ingest.quests.
# read_dimension_unlocks; any completed quest of a dimension's rows unlocks it. A raw input only
# that dimension's ore mixes (or a curated dimension source) give is rejected until then.
# Dimension names are spelled as GT's ore mixes name them (gt_ore_mixes.json, ore_mix.dims).
# Quest ids are BetterQuesting's compact ids (q:<id>); the names are for review only. Ids, names
# and the tasks quoted in the notes are from GTNH 2.9.0's DefaultQuests (tag 2.9.0, commit

# Rocket tiers: each "Rocket Tier N" quest is crafting that rocket. A note says where the book
# shows the dimension; "from GTNH's planet tiers" rows are not in the book (WO-3.10 F2).
